purpose: This table provides a cleaned, typed record of individual flight departures from New York City airports in 2013, feeding downstream analytics on flight delays, cancellations, and route performance.
usage: Consumers should treat each row as one scheduled flight departure identified by year, month, day, carrier, flight, and scheduled departure time; dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time may be null and should be filtered or handled explicitly when computing delay statistics, since nulls likely indicate cancelled or unrecorded flights.
limitations: Roughly 2.9% to 3.3% of rows have null dep_time, arr_time, dep_delay, arr_delay, or air_time, and 0.9% have null tailnum; these were retained as nulls rather than resolved, and no exact duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no row-level dedupe was applied.
